label: Date published
help: Year-month-day, like 2026-09-29. Posts are listed newest first.

label: Main picture
help: Shown at the top of the list of posts and when the post is shared.

label: One or two lines about it
help: Shown under the title in the list of posts, and in Google.

label: The post
help: Leave a blank line between paragraphs. Start a line with ## for a heading, or - for a list. **Two stars** make bold, and [words](https://address) make a link.
